notes: Pick Run: the window that asks which item a label goes in now fits on the screen, has a Folder choice and a search box, matches the label's size and service (never another service), learns how your folders write a service (DHWR is DHW), and can make a new size of a pipe. The button is Apply pipework. Runs can also go in without a label: Apply pipework… (or Enter), or click a pipe run in the Takeoff summary. Going back to a drawing tab keeps its zoom and place.
